hook: Hyderabad logs up to *200* streetlight complaints a day
hook_b: Hyderabad logs up to *200* streetlight complaints a day
tldr: Hyderabad CURE gets 150-200 streetlight complaints daily after EESL's contract ended; GHMC has issued an LoA for a Rs 1,720.83 crore, 10-year contract, with work expected by January 2027.

beats.what: The Hyderabad Core Urban Region receives 150-200 faulty-streetlight complaints daily, some taking days or weeks to fix, Siasat reported citing The New Indian Express.
beats.why: EESL's contract to maintain 5.42 lakh LED streetlights ended; staff shortage, a dysfunctional central monitoring system (CCMS) and material delays add to it.
beats.care: GHMC issued a Letter of Agreement to BAC Infratech and Vinci Global for 7.60 lakh lights, but the formal agreement is not yet signed.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Of the 7.60 lakh lights in the new contract, 3,30,487 are under GHMC, 1,85,258 under Cyberabad and 2,44,846 under Malkajgiri. Officials expect work to begin by January 2027.
